Data on homicide solve rates and case characteristics come from the FBI's [Supplementary Homicide Reports (SHR)](https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/LATEST/webapp/#/pages/downloads){target="_parent"}. The analysis includes murder and nonnegligent manslaughter and excludes manslaughter by negligence. SHR data do not record clearances, so a homicide counts as solved when the offender's age, sex, and race are known. Solve rates combine data from `r shr_first_year` through `r max(shr_state$year)` for more stable estimates.
